summary: Fixed the reproduced public production Evidence Ledger durable-poisoning defect in one Agent-only follow-up commit. The capture facet now validates and normalizes every runtime draft before EvidenceLedgerStore.append, so unknown tools, non-object/array inputs, missing/extra fields, non-string tool/callId/content/file, empty/present-undefined file, and malformed 1-based ranges fail with stable ALEMBIC_AGENT_EVIDENCE_LEDGER_CAPTURE_INVALID reason codes before E-n allocation, store mutation, or JSONL creation. A 26-case source regression and the built @alembic/agent/production consumer both prove file bytes/existence, store stats, and strict snapshot state are unchanged; the next valid capture remains E-1. The existing opaque factory/facets, private store, redaction, strict hydration/snapshot, AgentRuntime sharing, fresh-process reopen identity, and serialized V3 attestation remain intact.
